quick_skim.title: Sparse All-Layer Connector for Domain Generalised Semantic Segmentation
quick_skim.abstract: Domain generalised semantic segmentation (DGSS) has recently benefited from combining multiple foundation models, such as vision-language and vision foundation models, to leverage their diverse representations for generalisation. Existing multi-model approaches share a common design choice: cross-model fusion is restricted to depth-aligned layers, implicitly assuming that mutually beneficial information resides at the same depth across models. However, foundation models pretrained under different objectives may develop distinct representation hierarchies, making the optimality of depth-aligned fusion questionable. Moreover, we observe that the foundation models exhibit different depth-wise domain sensitivity. Motivated by these observations, we propose a Sparse All-Layer Connector (SALC) that enables each layer to access information from preceding layers of another model. As the number of accessible layers grows with depth, dense aggregation may hurt generalisation. SALC therefore learns to adaptively select a sparse subset of informative layers. We further introduce a candidate dropout regularisation that strengthens sparsity and encourages SALC to explore diverse layers, leading to more robust selection. Across four foundation model combinations and three DGSS evaluation settings, the proposed design demonstrates stronger generalisation than conventional depth-aligned fusion. The code is available at https://github.com/RuoyuGuo/SALC.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: Domain generalised semantic segmentation benefits from fusing multiple foundation models, yet existing methods only fuse depth-aligned layers. This work proposes a sparse all-layer connector that exploits depth-wise domain sensitivity, improving generalisation across domains.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 域泛化语义分割近年受益于融合视觉语言与视觉基础模型，但现有方法普遍假设不同模型在同一深度层的特征才互补，只做深度对齐的跨模型融合。作者观察到不同预训练目标导致表征层级差异，且各模型具有不同的深度域敏感性，于是提出稀疏全层连接器，跨层自适应地选择并融合互补特征。该方法在域泛化语义分割基准上提升了泛化性能，说明打破深度对齐假设对分割任务的跨域鲁棒性有实际价值。

quick_skim.title: Multimodal Fusion of RGB and Complementary Modalities for Semantic Segmentation
quick_skim.abstract: Multi-modal semantic segmentation adds an auxiliary sensing stream to RGB images (RGB-X), such as thermal, LiDAR, depth, event, polarization, or light field. This can improve robustness in poor lighting and under motion blur. But different sensors often produce features that do not match well, and fusion can become unstable. To alleviate these issues, we propose a bidirectional polarity-aware cross-modality fusion (BPCF) module that effectively captures complementary cues while enhancing feature alignment. We evaluate the framework on six modality pairings: RGB-Thermal, RGB-LiDAR, RGB-Depth, RGB-Event, RGB-Polarization, and RGB-Light Field. Our model achieve state-of-the-art (SOTA) results on eight public datasets, including MFNet, KITTI-360, DELIVER, DDD17, DSEC, MCubeS, ZJU, and UrbanLF. The codes and trained models will be released upon acceptance.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: Proposes a bidirectional polarity-aware cross-modality fusion module for RGB-X semantic segmentation, improving feature alignment and robustness across six modality pairings and eight public datasets.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 多模态语义分割通过引入热成像、LiDAR、深度、事件等辅助模态来提升低光照和运动模糊下的鲁棒性，但不同传感器特征难以对齐，融合往往不稳定。本文提出双向极性感知跨模态融合模块BPCF，在捕捉互补线索的同时增强跨模态特征对齐，并在RGB-热、RGB-LiDAR、RGB-深度、RGB-事件、RGB-偏振与RGB-光场六种组合上验证。该方法在MFNet、KITTI-360等八个公开数据集上取得最优结果，为多模态语义分割提供了稳定通用的融合方案。
